description_text: This is a Sources Sought Notice NOT a Solicitation. Questions will NOT be answered. All responses should be submitted by June 1, 2026, at 1630 cst. Sources Sought Notice Pre-Analytic Sample Tracking System, Brand Name or Equal to Rocky Mountain Regional VA Medical Center (RMRVAMC) Disclaimer: This Request for Information (RFI) is issued solely for market research information and planning purposes and does not constitute a solicitation. All information received in response to this RFI that is marked as proprietary will be handled accordingly. Responses to this notice are NOT offers and cannot be accepted by the Government to form a binding contract. Responders are solely responsible for all expenses associated with responding to this RFI. Information Requested from Industry: In response to the Sources Sought, interested Contractors shall submit the following information and any Capabilities/Qualifications Statement to include but not limited to an overview of proposed solution(s) and a description of the product your company possesses in accordance with the Statement of Work draft / Salient Characteristics List. Responses to market research table questionnaire shall be submitted. If this information is not provided, then it will be assumed the entire requirement cannot be met. Description of Requirement: The Department of Veterans Affairs, Veterans Health Administration (VHA), Network Contracting Office 19 (NCO 19) is conducting a market survey and is seeking potential sources for Pre-Analytic Sample Tracking System, Brand Name or Equal To for the Rocky Mountain Regional VA Medical Center. This Sources Sought Notice is issued for information and planning purposes only. This is not a solicitation or a request for proposal and shall not be construed as an obligation or commitment by the Government. An award will not be made on any offers submitted in response to this notice, and it shall not be implied that the Government is committed to providing any solicitation or award following this notice. The Government will not pay for any information received in response to this request, nor will the Government compensate a respondent for any costs incurred in developing the information provided. Period of Performance: 8/31/2026-8/30/2031 Brand Name or Equal to Abbott AlinIQ Indexor system. The Equal To offer must meet or exceed all of the following salient characteristics: Description Part Number Qty Indexor Standard Package 04U96-24 2 Indexor Box of 48 iRacks - 13 mm 04Z08-56 3 Indexor Box of 48 iRacks - 16 mm 04Z08-57 2 Indexor Box of 48 iRack Covers 04Z08-58 5 Indexor iLogger Transport Case - Four Position 04U96-98 18 Indexor iLogger Transport Case - Two Position 04Z08-99 26 AlinIQ Digital Training - License 01DH5-09 1 ITS Training - onsite 1x annually, includes 10 hours at $250/hour and travel 04Z08-92 1 Indexor Mini Package 04U96-95 15 Indexor Always on Support Contract 04Z08-74 1 Indexor Always on Support Contract 04Z08-74 1 AlinIQ Digital Training - License 01DH5-09 1 ITS Training - onsite 1x annually, includes 10 hours at $250/hour and travel 04Z08-92 1 Indexor iLogger Transport Case - Two Position 04U96-98 1 Indexor iLogger Transport Case - Four Position 04U96-98 1 AlinIQ Digital Training - Indexor, 3 Licenses 01DH5-09 1 System must be new, current-generation equipment and software. Used or refurbished equipment is NOT acceptable All components must be OEM manufactured or authorized. System must include OEM warranty beginning at contract award. OEM service must be available and performed by OEM technicians. System must provide end-to-end automated specimen tracking and chain-of-custody visibility from collection through laboratory receipt. System must use barcode-based specimen identification. System must support rack-based specimen association and bulk receipt of multiple specimens simultaneously to support high-volume workflows. System must display specimen status without removing tubes from racks. System must provide specimen search capability by ID. System must allow reassignment of specimen positions without rescanning. System must provide confirmation alerts for successful specimen entry and alerts for unscanned placements. System must support collection workflow that does not require manual login steps and must support badge authentication when user identification is required. Collection units must support minimum capacity of 120 specimen tubes. System must record transport temperature and impact events and automatically upload environmental data upon arrival. System must integrate with VA laboratory systems using HL7 or ASTM protocols and support distributed collection sites and centralized laboratory workflows. System must support wired or wireless connectivity. System must fit standard clinical workspace surfaces and be cleanable for clinical environments. System must include all accessories required for operation. System must be fully supported by the original manufacturers including parts, firmware, and updates.
